procedure: Use the sodium bicarbonate and vinegar method or the caustic-cleaner method as separate alternatives; never use them one after the other or mix them.
For the first method, pour half a cup of sodium bicarbonate solution into the drain, followed by half a cup of vinegar.
Cover the drain loosely and wait for thirty minutes.
Pour hot water down the drain carefully; avoid splashing.
For the alternative method, a teacher or responsible adult may pour caustic chemical drain cleaner into the drain, following its label and wearing suitable protective equipment.
Wait for half an hour and then flush the drain with water, as directed on the cleaner’s label.
aim: To describe how sodium bicarbonate solution and vinegar, or a caustic drain cleaner, can be used to help clear a blocked drain.

viva.question: What is the common name of sodium bicarbonate?
What type of substance is vinegar?
viva.answer: It is an acidic solution containing acetic acid.

viva.question: Which gas is produced when vinegar reacts with sodium bicarbonate?
What is the formula of sodium bicarbonate?
Why must vinegar and caustic drain cleaner not be mixed?
viva.answer: They may react dangerously, causing heat or splashing, and the cleaner can cause severe chemical burns.

diagram: Draw a drain and label the sodium bicarbonate solution, vinegar, loose cover and hot water; show the caustic-cleaner method separately and label it as an alternative.
title: Cleaning a blocked drain
precautions: Do not mix caustic drain cleaner with vinegar, sodium bicarbonate solution or any other cleaner.
Never tightly seal the drain during the vinegar and sodium bicarbonate method, because carbon dioxide gas is produced.
Keep caustic drain cleaner away from students; it should be handled only by a responsible adult according to its label.
Wear protective gloves and safety goggles when handling drain-cleaning chemicals.
Pour hot water carefully to prevent splashing and burns.
result: Sodium bicarbonate solution followed by vinegar produces carbon dioxide, while a caustic cleaner can dissolve some common blockage materials. The methods are alternatives and must not be combined.
